policy: rejection first: every candidate is attacked before it is promoted (RFC-035S2 section 12)
log_hash_algorithm: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the entries array

entries.TITLE: NostalgiaForInfinity — multi-pair 5m Freqtrade strategy
counter_evidence: the README's own recommendations leave the universe and the number of open trades to the user
results are published as commit comments, so the 'original result' is not a stable artifact
the bundled auto-updater (nfi-updater) keeps changing the strategy, which breaks any frozen replication
a 5m strategy with a long tail (-stoploss in config) faces the project's 23.791 bps round trip on every round turn

entries.TITLE: Crypto and Stock Momentum (QuantConnect Quant League 2024-Q4)
counter_evidence: the entry is marked 'pending review' and carried no readable metrics when it was fetched
half of the universe (US equities) cannot be traded by this project's crypto runtime
an explicit EMA100 + RSI + dual Supertrend + TWAP stack on a self-selected universe is a candidate for overfitting rather than a published result

entries.TITLE: Bitcoin MAX/Min breakout — Quantpedia's 2024 revisit (buy at the 10-day maximum)
counter_evidence: the out-of-sample test was run by the same author as the in-sample study
the MIN leg did not survive out of sample, which is the direction the article had previously recommended as a combination
no position rule means the published result cannot be turned into trades without our own choices

entries.TITLE: Trend-following and Mean-reversion in Bitcoin (Quantpedia, 2022) — the earlier study
counter_evidence: only a search snippet was available for this round, so it is registered for completeness and not used as evidence

entries.TITLE: pysystemtrade / Carver's diversified trend-following system
counter_evidence: reproducing it exactly requires a futures account, margin and 100 markets — none of which this project can trade
keeping only the trend component on BTC spot would be a new strategy, and the mission forbids relabelling our own design as an external replication

entries.TITLE: G-Research Crypto Forecasting (Kaggle 2022) — winning forecasting solutions
counter_evidence: strong evidence for a forecasting model, zero evidence for a tradable rule set
the winning solutions are trained models with per-competitor pipelines, so no single external strategy exists to replicate

entries.TITLE: bitcoin-momentum-trading — 5-minute ML momentum direction model
counter_evidence: 5-minute crypto horizons are the regime the project's admission cost already killed internally
the model is retrained, so the 'same strategy' cannot be evaluated twice

entries.TITLE: Adaptive Regime-Based Trading on Bitcoin (15-minute, walk-forward)
counter_evidence: a 15-minute cadence is structurally at odds with this project's measured cost floor
the claim could not be inspected beyond the abstract

entries.TITLE: Reflective LLM-based agent for zero-shot cryptocurrency trading
counter_evidence: an LLM-dependent system cannot be re-run identically: the model version and prompt are part of the strategy and are not frozen artifacts

entries.TITLE: CGA-Agent — genetic-algorithm optimisation of crypto strategy parameters
counter_evidence: an optimiser that adapts parameters to recent data guarantees look-ahead risk in any replication that reuses its fitted values
returns of +550% on one asset over an unspecified window are not comparable with anything this project measures

entries.TITLE: Daily ML direction trading on Bitcoin with a real unseen-period test (Crone, Brophy, Ward)
counter_evidence: the same paper documents that a widely cited benchmark in this literature trained on its own test data and mis-applied PCA — a reminder that this literature's reported numbers need auditing
a three-month test window cannot separate skill from a lucky regime

entries.TITLE: Karaptic Research — published-strategy replication series net of fees and slippage
counter_evidence: the site's own honest-timestamp re-run cut the headline win rate from 85-100% to 63%, which is precisely the kind of correction this project's methodology demands
it is a venue for replications rather than an external strategy: the notes describe the author's own detector as well

entries.TITLE: Multi-Band Comparison Strategy (CRYPTO) — published Pine Script strategy
counter_evidence: TradingView strategies are commonly tuned to one symbol and period, and the tester's default cost settings are optimistic relative to this project's 23.791 bps floor

entries.TITLE: Deep Momentum Networks (Lim/Zohren/Roberts and successors)
counter_evidence: a trained network is a pipeline, not a rule set: two runs are not the same strategy

entries.TITLE: An Adaptive Multi-Agent Bitcoin Trading System (LLM-driven)
counter_evidence: the system's decision layer is a proprietary model, so its behaviour cannot be frozen or audited

entries.TITLE: Momentum Trading in Cryptocurrencies: time-series vs cross-sectional (comparative study)
counter_evidence: long/short cross-sectional momentum cannot be expressed in a long/cash spot runtime without inventing a long-only variant

notes: a reason code is attached to the candidate it kills; a candidate may carry several codes
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and WATCH candidates are listed here too: they were not promoted, so the log records why
